A garden in the city

Beba is at Pindarou 2a in Nicosia. Guests sit in the dining room or in the courtyard behind it, under trees strung with lights. The kitchen works with charcoal and a wood oven, and the menu changes with the season. Open Monday to Saturday for lunch and dinner.

What guests say

Three of 1,158 Google reviews, 910 of them with five stars.

“Lovely restaurant serving authentic local dishes. The waiters were exceptionally welcoming and genuinely friendly. We followed their recommendations and were pleasantly impressed by every course. The halloumi with tomato marmalade and mint pesto was absolutely outstanding.”

Google review
“Amazing place to have a business or casual lunch. Great selection of dishes, including cooked, legumes, fish and meat. Nice starter and great service. Overall quality is really high, from the atmoshere, nice outside garden, to the ingredients and staff. Will visit again for sure.”

Google review
“Beautiful atmosphere and yummy food. Really enjoyed this restaurant. Make sure to book in advance because it’s generally always full! Thank you!”
